A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same LookCloser/FA-NeRF work, with all 17 pages and supplementary Sections 7-9 available. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish that only the first-page arXiv version/date stamp differs.

before.justification: v1 reports original rendering evaluations, frequency-quantification experiments, and component ablations in Section 5 and the supplementary material.

after.justification: v3 retains the same original empirical results, including benchmark comparisons, frequency-quantification experiments, and ablations.

M1.justification: The frequency quantification, frequency grid, feature re-weighting, frequency-averaged sampling, adaptive ray marching, and training losses are identical in Sections 4 and 7.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same Multi-frequency dataset, Mip-NeRF360 and Tanks&Temples scenes, and synthetic cubes-and-gears examples. No dataset, task, or test scenario changes.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in corresponding experiments: TensoRF, iNGP-Base/Big, Mip-NeRF360, and 3D-GS in Tables 1-2, plus original and adapted BungeeNeRF in Figure 6 and Table 15.

E3.justification: Sections 5.1 and 7 retain identical splits, resolutions, model configurations, training budgets, and metrics, including every-eighth-image testing and PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS evaluation.

E4.justification: The frequency-quantification analyses in Figures 3 and 7 and component ablations in Tables 3 and 7 are identical. No robustness, sensitivity, or supplementary analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical throughout the main and supplementary results. No run counts, seed information, uncertainty estimates, or significance tests are added or removed.

E6.justification: All numerical entries and qualitative findings match, including Tables 1-15. For example, Table 1 reports the same FA-NeRF structure-view and detail-view PSNR values of 32.44 and 26.29 in both versions.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, frequency projection, feature-weighting expressions, sampling reasoning, and loss formulations in the main text and supplement are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about jointly reconstructing scene structure and tiny details, frequency-aware modeling, baseline performance, and generalization.

C2.justification: The explanations of sampling and feature allocation, interpretations of ablations, generalization discussion, and remaining opportunity for rendering acceleration are unchanged.

D1.justification: Sections 5.1 and 7 contain identical camera processing, architecture, grid-update, optimizer, loss-weight, and hardware details. No implementation or code/data access information changes.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, research positioning, and all 57 references are identical. No cited work or relationship to prior research changes.

P1.justification: Only the first-page marginal arXiv stamp changes from v1 dated 24 March 2025 to v3 dated 29 July 2025. The paper's prose, terminology, headings, and organization are identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1-10 and Tables 1-15 retain identical displays and placement. Rendered pages 2-17 match exactly; page 1 differs only in the administrative version/date stamp.

improvement.justification: The scientific content, results, explanations, visual presentation, and supplementary reproducibility details are unchanged. Updating only the arXiv version/date stamp produces no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
